editorial_review_row.author: NAFT Editorial
editorial_review_row.content: Libertex is a CySEC-regulated broker scoring 6.2/10 from NAFT in 2026. Unique zero-spread, commission-only pricing model. Operating since 1997 — one of the oldest retail brokers. $10 minimum deposit. Single CySEC regulation and 80% retail loss rate limit the score significantly. Best for traders curious about commission-only pricing from a long-established brand.
